excluded: all downstream edges and motor readouts
anatomy.selection: existing graph edges whose exact annotated presynaptic type and exact postsynaptic subtype match one ordered group

execution_authority.next_authorized_action: implement and run the disposable one-update preflight

edge_gain_multipliers.group_sharing: source type x target subtype, bilateral and column-shared

purpose: freeze topology and stimulus specifications before outcome-bearing work

schema.canonical_semantic_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, finite values only

pair_semantics.edge_center: 60 + phase_row_numerator / 2^53 at the middle of the motion window
pair_semantics.edge_orientation: orientation reverses with branch so every crossed pixel increases for ON and decreases for OFF
pair_semantics.hard_edge_threshold_equality: down branch selects row <= center; up branch selects row >= center
pair_semantics.literal_reverse: reverse the 16 moving frames and use the corresponding normal final moving frame as the stationary baseline
pair_semantics.pixel_centers: integer row and column coordinates starting at zero
pair_semantics.stationary_branch: the corresponding branch's first moving frame
pair_semantics.terminal: one shared uniform linear-gray frame at 0.5

texture_renderer_sealed_specification.normalization: divide by maximum absolute spatial sample
texture_renderer_sealed_specification.translation: integer cyclic image-row shifts with no interpolation

acceptance.raw_draw_order: edge phases in phase-bin order, then texture realizations
